{{Top|leg}}
A '''superdreadnaught''' was a class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' was considered a superdreadnaught. The term was also utilized around the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as well as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] &ndash; in particular with the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''.
